lines.text: Bel and Nebo crouch, their idols weigh down beasts and cattle, and the gods themselves go into captivity.
The LORD says He has carried Israel since birth and will bear them up when they turn gray.
People hire a goldsmith to make a god from silver, then carry it on their shoulders, and it cannot answer.
The LORD says there is no other God, and He summons a roaring lion from the east for His purpose.
The LORD tells stubborn people He is bringing His righteousness near and will grant salvation to Zion without delay.
